venue.name: Gildas Box of Treasures Theatre
venue.description: Gildas Box of Treasures Theatre is listed in this catalog as a First Nations dance and performance venue in Campbell River, on Ligwilda'xw territory. The only address we had for it is a page on an outside educational directory, not a site the theatre runs, and that page no longer opens: the link now lands on the directory's own home page instead. We could find no website belonging to the theatre and no mention of it anywhere on the Wei Wai Kum First Nation site, which is where the Nation lists the businesses and facilities it runs in Campbell River. Nothing about performances, times, prices, ages or group visits could be confirmed from the venue itself, and we cannot confirm it is still putting on performances at all.

gaps: NO VENUE WEBSITE. The address in the tracker, www.native-dance.ca/en/showcase/gildas-box-of-treasures-theatre/, is a page on Native Dance, a third party educational directory about Indigenous dance in Canada. It is not a site the theatre owns, so nothing on it is eligible as a source under our rules and nothing from it has been recorded here.

TRACKER URL IS BROKEN. Checked in a live browser on 2026-09-07. https://native-dance.ca/ and https://www.native-dance.ca/ refuse the connection outright over https. The http form loads, then silently redirects the whole path to https://indigenousdance.ca/en/home/, the directory's home page. The showcase page for this theatre is gone. A fetch of the original address returns an almost empty body and looks harmless, so a fetch only re-run will not notice this.

OPERATING STATUS UNCONFIRMED, TREAT AS DORMANT. The theatre sits with the Wei Wai Kum First Nation (Campbell River Indian Band) in Campbell River. Their site at weiwaikum.ca lists every business and facility they run, including the House of Treasures gallery, Thunderbird Hall, the marina, the shopping centres and the RV park. The theatre appears on none of those lists, on the Facility Rentals page or on the Our Culture page, and a site search for 'Gildas' returns no results. That is not proof of closure, but there is no live evidence anywhere on the operator's own domain that performances are still running.

One web search was done to look for a site belonging to the theatre or to a Kwakwaka'wakw cultural organisation running it. Everything returned was a third party listing or an old tourism directory. gildasboxoftreasures.com, boxoftreasures.ca and gildas.ca do not resolve. Weiwaikumhouseoftreasures.com exists but is the Nation's retail art gallery and gift shop, and says nothing about a theatre or about performances.

no address published on any venue owned page, so there are no coordinates and this record cannot be mapped. Third party directories do give a Campbell River street address, but a directory is not a source and it has not been recorded.
Nothing is known about price, youngest age welcomed, group size, how much notice a booking needs, lunch space, washrooms or wet weather cover.
No programs have been created. There is no venue owned page saying groups are welcome, so 'hosts school groups' and 'hosts daycare groups' are unknown rather than no.
images: none. There is no venue owned domain to take a photograph from, so there is no hero image and the record cannot be published.

Suggested next step is a phone call to Wei Wai Kum First Nation reception on 1-250-286-6949 to ask whether the theatre still runs performances and whether school or daycare groups can book one. If the answer is no, this row should be retired rather than re-run.
